## Prognostic-gene comparison: Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA) vs Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA) — HPA

**Universe & definitions (all from `cancer_prognostic_data` restricted to Ensembl genes present in the `proteinatlas` master table)**
- Master-table Ensembl genes: **20,162**; all **19,973** genes of each cancer cohort are in the master (so no exclusion occurred).
- "Favourable" = non-empty *potential prognostic – favorable* OR *validated prognostic – favorable* p-value; "unfavourable" = non-empty *potential/validated – unfavorable*. A gene can have at most one of potential/validated per direction (verified via full flag crosstab), and **no gene in either cancer was flagged both favourable and unfavourable** (verified: 0 for both cancers).

### 1. Favourable / unfavourable gene counts per cancer

| Cohort | Favourable | Unfavourable |
|---|---|---|
| Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA) | **6,430** | **1,106** |
| Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA) | **458** | **1,049** |

(Fine-grained column counts: kidney potential-favourable 4,791 / validated-favourable 1,639 / potential-unfavourable 842 / validated-unfavourable 264; lung potential-favourable 453 / validated-favourable 5 / potential-unfavourable 847 / validated-unfavourable 202 — unions give the totals above.)

### 2. Direction overlap (intersection of the two cohorts, n = 685 genes prognostic in both)

| Direction pair | Count |

| Opposite direction: kidney favourable / lung unfavourable | **324** |

| **Total opposite direction** | **345** |
| **Prognostic in either direction in both cancers** | **685** (= 340 + 345 ✓) |

The kidney cohort is dominated by favourable-prognostic genes; by contrast, in lung adenocarcinoma unfavourable genes outnumber favourable ones ~2.3 : 1 — and most shared kidney-favourable genes reverse direction in lung (324 of 324+21).
